body: On 2026-11-07, for the Mac Questly run, I sent a delegate a GO, then a hold, then GO for option A, then option B, each time crossing with Asistant or Greg messages. The delegate got four contradictory instructions in five minutes. Lesson: when Greg's own words already answer the question (for example „użyć tej ścieżki i kontynuować testy”), act on them and don't also offer him options. If I do offer options, send the delegate ONE hold and ONE final instruction, plus the rule "don't interrupt a run already started, and never run two in parallel".
